baseline_fields.evidence_summary: One Fabric now has a bounded authenticated A2A 1.0 HTTP+JSON edge in repository/two-process CI scope while PCEF remains execution authority. Agent Cards declare Bearer security; short-lived signed capability tokens bind issuer, subject, tenant, audience, operation scopes and PCEF authority ceilings; deterministic task ownership is durably reserved before ingress; Get/List/Cancel/follow-up/duplicate handling is caller-scoped and fail-closed; ListTasks is ACL-first; cross-principal takeover and resource projection are rejected; same-principal retries survive credential rotation; token revocation survives store reopen; router-to-specialist service authentication completes with eight verified PCEF receipts on both processes. Production HTTPS/TLS, OAuth/OIDC, independent third-party A2A interoperability, native binding and external-provider effects remain unproven/not implemented.
baseline_fields.single_extra_feature: Sovereign Proof-Carrying Autonomy: authenticated interoperability binds caller identity, operation scope and authority to durable task ownership before consequential execution, then still requires PCEF proof before terminal completion.
baseline_fields.8x8_parity_gate: Promote the authenticated A2A edge to a real HTTPS/TLS deployment with independent third-party interoperability while preserving caller-scoped ACL-first authorization, crash-safe ownership reservation, non-escalating authority and PCEF terminal proof.

frontier_patch.definition: Every consequential agent/tool/external effect must carry authorization-bound, idempotent, replay-verifiable proof before terminal completion; interoperability must authenticate the caller and reserve durable authority/ownership before ingress; risky execution must prove isolation; guarded runs must prove session/guardrail/trace completeness; historical replay must preserve immutable proof lineage.
